name: Stockramp
summary: A fictional parts desk that flags a premium buy. Sample data, not a real inventory product.
paragraphs: Stockramp, in this sample, compares a rush purchase with stock already on the shelf, at a sister station, or on a loaner list. It does not place the order. A planner still does.
A real parts tool would need the operator's approved vendors and the actual on-hand counts. This page does not offer that connection.
whyItMatters: Premium buys are the expensive way to close a gap. Catching one before it is placed is a direct cut to the parts bill.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: Parts suppliers and operators looking at the directory format.
